description: This file defines an interface for a grain that tracks and injects storage faults in an Orleans distributed application. It provides methods to add faults for specific storage operations and to trigger exceptions based on grain IDs.

classes.name: IStorageFaultGrain
classes.description: Interface for a grain that injects storage faults to simulate exceptions during storage operations in Orleans grains.

methods.name: AddFaultOnRead
methods.description: Adds a storage exception to be thrown when the referenced grain reads state from a storage provider.

methods.name: AddFaultOnWrite
methods.description: Adds a storage exception to be thrown when the referenced grain writes state to a storage provider.

methods.name: AddFaultOnClear
methods.description: Adds a storage exception to be thrown when the referenced grain clears state in a storage provider.

methods.name: OnRead
methods.description: Throws a storage exception if one has been added for the grain reference for reading.

methods.name: OnWrite
methods.description: Throws a storage exception if one has been added for the grain reference for writing.

methods.name: OnClear
methods.description: Throws a storage exception if one has been added for the grain reference for clearing state.
